datasets.title: Afghanistan - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Afghanistan with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/afghanistan-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters from gridded datasets, assigning representative points to each cluster, and using Voronoi tessellation or similar spatial algorithms to delineate catchment boundaries. Population counts from multiple sources (WorldPop, Kontur, Meta) were aggregated and disaggregated by sex and age, while building counts were derived from OpenStreetMap and Google building detection datasets. The resulting dataset provides baseline exposure inventories for three provinces in Afghanistan.

sources.name: WorldPop

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: Alternative gridded population dataset (2023) providing population estimates for settlement areas

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: Population data disaggregated by sex and age groups (2023) for demographic characterization of settlements

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint data used to count structures within settlement catchment areas

sources.name: Google
sources.description: Machine learning-derived building detection data at multiple confidence thresholds for building inventory
